result.message: Testing stage. You will be given 3 test inputs, one at a time and answered separately. Apply the same transformation rule to each and submit the predicted output grid with submit_final_answer.

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v]
    if not pts:return out
    color=grid[pts[0][0]][pts[0][1]]
    js=[j for i,j in pts]; is_=[i for i,j in pts]
    # axis is midpoint of horizontal extent, rounded as indicated by symmetric shapes
    c=(min(js)+max(js))//2
    for i in range(max(is_)+1,len(grid)):
        out[i][c]=color
    return out"}

{"code":"def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    cells=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(grid) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x!=0]
    if not cells: return out
    color=grid[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
    rs=[i for i,j in cells]; cs=[j for i,j in cells]
    rmax=max(rs); cmin=min(cs); cmax=max(cs)
    c=(cmin+cmax)//2
    for i in range(rmax+1,len(grid)):
        out[i][c]=color
    return out"}
